cases.explain: «кропильных чаш» — the genitive here marks possession, absence, or quantity.
cases.translation: He made also ten tables, and placed them in the temple, five on the right side, and five on the left. He made one hundred basins of gold.

cases.sentence: Он сделал двор для священников, ___ и двери для двора, и покрыл двери бронзой.
cases.explain: «большой двор» — the subject of the sentence stands in the nominative.
cases.translation: Furthermore he made the court of the priests, the great court, and doors for the court, and overlaid their doors with bronze.

cases.sentence: четыреста ___ для двух сеток (два ряда гранатов для каждой сетки, украшавшей чашеобразные капители),
cases.explain: «гранатовых плодов» — the genitive here marks possession, absence, or quantity.
cases.translation: and the four hundred pomegranates for the two networks; two rows of pomegranates for each network, to cover the two bowls of the capitals that were on the pillars.

cases.sentence: Царь велел отлить ее в ___ в долине Иордана между Суккотом и Цередатой .
cases.explain: «глиняных формах» — after the preposition «в», for location or topic.
cases.translation: The king cast them in the plain of the Jordan, in the clay ground between Succoth and Zeredah.

cases.sentence: Еще Соломон сделал всю утварь для ___:
cases.explain: «Божьего дома» — after the preposition «для», the genitive here marks possession, absence, or quantity.
cases.translation: Solomon made all the vessels that were in God’s house, the golden altar also, and the tables with the show bread on them;

cases.sentence: подсвечники из ___ со светильниками, чтобы они горели перед внутренним святилищем, как предписано,
cases.explain: «чистого золота» — after the preposition «из», the genitive here marks possession, absence, or quantity.
cases.translation: and the lamp stands with their lamps, to burn according to the ordinance before the inner sanctuary, of pure gold;

cases.sentence: подсвечники из чистого золота со светильниками, чтобы они горели перед ___, как предписано,
cases.explain: «внутренним святилищем» — after the preposition «перед», the instrumental marks the means, company, or complement.
cases.translation: and the lamp stands with their lamps, to burn according to the ordinance before the inner sanctuary, of pure gold;

cases.sentence: золотые цветы, светильники и щипцы (они были из ___),
cases.explain: «чистого золота» — after the preposition «из», the genitive here marks possession, absence, or quantity.
cases.translation: and the flowers, the lamps, and the tongs of gold that was perfect gold;

cases.sentence: ножницы для фитилей, кропильные чаши, блюда и сосуды для возжигания благовоний — все из ___,
cases.explain: «чистого золота» — after the preposition «из», the genitive here marks possession, absence, or quantity.
cases.translation: and the snuffers, the basins, the spoons, and the fire pans of pure gold. As for the entry of the house, its inner doors for the most holy place and the doors of the main hall of the temple were of gold.
